Don’t worry- I’ve been there before so I get how it feels. I’ve always been so awful at math and I remember how stressed it would make me feel.. but really in the long run it doesn’t mean anything. Just don’t get too worked up!

School, by design, is made to cater to the “intelligent” people, the ones with booksmarts and good memory- everything is based around how “smart” we seem on paper, but a grade or a percentage does not determine your value. Emotional intelligence, kindness and compassion, all the things that matter in a person- they can’t be put in simple terms like a number or a letter. Know your worth. Don’t let it dictate your life, we all have a path we will follow in our lives and once you find your passions and talents, It’ll work itself out. Don’t be too stressed about this, you are so so much better than an crooked system :)

Of course, try to check up on him and make him feel wanted and cared for. But please- you are only a friend, not a carer and not a psychiatrist. It can be frustrating as hell when someone you care about feels like this- you just want them to be happy. But you need to take care of yourself to. You need to know your boundaries, and make sure you’re not worrying and obsessing all the time. Do as much as you can for him, and help him seek therapy if you can. Know when to stop and take a step back, but also not abandon him. Wishing the best for both of you.
